references.text: The seven days of consecration for Aaron and his sons were completed, and the eighth day marked the beginning of their priestly service.
The instruction regarding the seven-day consecration for the priests, leading up to the eighth day mentioned here.
Moses gathered Aaron, his sons, and the congregation at the entrance of the tabernacle for the consecration, paralleling this gathering.
Moses called Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of Israel's elders up to the Lord, similar to the assembly of leadership.
Israel's elders played a significant role in leadership and were often summoned by Moses on important occasions.
The tabernacle was erected on the first day of the first month, and this eighth day marked the completion of the consecration process.
